dedupe_keys.name: julia kite power tools simulator suite

description: KiteSimulators is the Aenarete-hosted Julia meta-package for simulating airborne wind-energy systems. It brings together kite, winch, controller and viewer components and supplies graphical autopilot and joystick applications. Inputs are configuration files, control settings and, optionally, joystick commands; outputs are kite and winch trajectories, logged quantities and plots over a configured power cycle. Coverage is an engineered system, not a fixed region, with model resolution and run duration set by the experiment. Source is free under MIT, with a TU Delft copyright waiver and installation guides. A limitation is that OpenGL is required and the documented installation needs substantial memory and disk space; supplied demonstrations do not establish performance for arbitrary kite designs. The suite can assess airborne wind-energy operation and controls. welib (platform-welib) supplies related wind-engineering calculations. This parent record explicitly covers the listed supporting packages. No models or graphical software were installed.
